Major Projects: 
 
Project: Cisco ASA to Palo Alto NGFW Migration 
 
Overview: 
This project involved migrating the organization’s network security infrastructure from Cisco ASA firewalls to Palo Alto 
Networks Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFWs). The objective was to enhance network security, improve application 
visibility, strengthen threat prevention capabilities, and simplify firewall management while ensuring minimal downtime 
during the migration. 
 
Key Responsibilities: 
 
• Analyzed and reviewed the existing Cisco ASA firewall configuration, including access control lists (ACLs), NAT 
policies, VPN configurations, and security rules. 
• Planned and executed the migration strategy by translating Cisco ASA policies into Palo Alto security policies using 
best practices. 
• Configured security zones, interfaces, virtual routers, NAT rules, security policies, and service objects on Palo Alto 
firewalls. 
• Migrated site-to-site and remote access VPN configurations while validating secure connectivity. 
• Performed policy optimization by consolidating redundant rules and implementing application-based security using 
App-ID. 
• Enabled advanced security features such as Threat Prevention, URL Filtering, Anti-Virus, Anti-Spyware, and 
WildFire integration. 
• Conducted pre-migration validation, post-migration testing, and troubleshooting to ensure seamless connectivity and 
application availability. 
• Worked closely with network, security, and application teams during implementation and change windows to 
minimize business impact. 
• Monitored firewall performance and security logs using Palo Alto monitoring tools and generated reports for 
validation and compliance. 
• Documented migration procedures, firewall configurations, rollback plans, and operational handover documentation.

Project: Enterprise Network Migration to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) 
 
Overview: 
This project focused on migrating enterprise network infrastructure from traditional on-premises data centers to cloud 
environments hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Amazon Web Services (AWS). The primary objective was to 
improve scalability, availability, security, and operational efficiency while enabling a hybrid and cloud-first architecture. 
 
Key Responsibilities: 
• Assessed the existing on-premises network architecture and developed a cloud migration strategy. 
• Designed and configured Virtual Cloud Networks (VCNs) in OCI and Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) in AWS. 
• Configured subnets, route tables, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, Service Gateways, Security Lists, Network 
Security Groups (NSGs), and Security Groups. 
• Established secure connectivity between on-premises data centers and cloud environments using IPSec VPNs and 
dedicated connectivity (FastConnect for OCI and Direct Connect for AWS, where applicable). 
• Implemented network segmentation, access control policies, and firewall security to protect cloud resources. 
• Migrated applications and workloads while ensuring minimal downtime and maintaining business continuity. 
• Configured load balancers, DNS services, and high-availability architectures to improve application performance 
and resilience. 
• Performed network validation, connectivity testing, troubleshooting, and performance optimization after migration. 
• Collaborated with cloud, network, security, and application teams throughout planning, implementation, and post-
migration support. 
• Prepared migration documentation, network diagrams, rollback procedures, and operational handover documents.
